llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple scam signs such as excessive bonuses, guaranteed payment phrasing, 90% discounts, urgency tactics, and new member promotions. All login and registration links redirect to a suspicious short-URL, not a legitimate secured business login page. The page mimics the appearance and branding of Lazada but is on a non-affiliated domain (biji88.me), suggesting spoofing. There is no traceable company information, privacy or payment details are ambiguous or missing, and there are references to slot/gambling scams. These match several scam characteristics, confirming the nature as a Fake Online Shopping scam.
